title: From Jam to Course: Foundations of Consistent Content

posts.author: Nullshot
posts.body: Welcome to our jam! Let's align on the foundations of consistent content.

posts.author: Nullshot
posts.body:
### What is consistency?
Consistency means your audience knows what to expect and when.

posts.author: Taylor
posts.body:
Bullet reminders:
- set a cadence
- reuse pillars
- measure impact

posts.author: Ari
posts.body: We documented a playbook on topic pillars last quarter. Worth resurfacing.

posts.author: Nullshot
posts.body:
#### Cadence frameworks
1. Monday planning
2. Midweek production
3. Friday retros

posts.author: Dee
posts.body:
Q: How do you keep cross-functional partners aligned?
A: share the content roadmap weekly.

posts.author: Taylor
posts.body: We ran an experiment comparing solo vs squad execution.

posts.author: Taylor
posts.body: The squad outperformed by 24% because accountability increased.

posts.author: Maya
posts.body: Reminder to document learnings in the knowledge base.

posts.author: Nullshot
posts.body: Checklist: brief, draft, review, publish, retro.

posts.author: Ari
posts.body: Story formats still matter. Anchor each piece in a narrative arc.

posts.author: Dee
posts.body: Reflect: when did we last share the vision behind a series?

posts.author: Maya
posts.body:
### Templates
- kickoff doc
- asset tracker
- retro prompts

posts.author: Nullshot
posts.body:
Q: What metrics show quality is holding?
A: completion rate and qualitative feedback.

posts.author: Taylor
posts.body: The jam ends with an ask: pilot the new ritual next sprint.

posts.author: Ari
posts.body:
#### Quick wins
Celebrate teams that share learnings openly.

posts.author: Maya
posts.body: Embrace iteration. Every retro should surface a micro-experiment.

posts.author: Nullshot
posts.body: Let's wrap: consistent content is deliberate, measured, and co-created.
